title.zh: Senate Republicans Post Revised CLARITY Act Text Five Days Before Cloture Vote
title.en: Senate Republicans Post Revised CLARITY Act Text Five Days Before Cloture Vote

current_state.zh: Senate Republicans released a revised CLARITY Act substitute that imposes CFTC registration and Bank Secrecy Act obligations on non-decentralized trading protocols, narrows the DeFi title to spot and cash digital commodity transactions, and clarifies credit union digital asset powers ahead of a cloture vote in five days.
current_state.en: Senate Republicans released a revised CLARITY Act substitute that imposes CFTC registration and Bank Secrecy Act obligations on non-decentralized trading protocols, narrows the DeFi title to spot and cash digital commodity transactions, and clarifies credit union digital asset powers ahead of a cloture vote in five days.
